description: This file contains an implementation of the MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm compatible with OpenSSL, including functions for initializing, updating, and finalizing MD5 hashes, along with internal transformation routines.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context with standard starting values.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Processes input data to update the MD5 hash.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Completes the MD5 hash computation and outputs the digest.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Processes 64-byte blocks of data for MD5 transformation.
